calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS transaction_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS avg_basket_value
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

SELECT MIN(sale_date) AS min_date, MAX(sale_date) AS max_date, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_in_period
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND sale_date <= '2026-08-30'

SELECT DISTINCT store_key, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY store_key
ORDER BY store_key
LIMIT 20

  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS avg_basket_value
